When the Portilla family, owners of a fortune, announces the search for a new face for their sports brand, Ofelia sees an opportunity to achieve her goal, regardless of who she has to push out of her way.

overview: Escenas de matrimonio is a comedy television series premiered on Telecinco in 2007 and produced by Alba Adriatica. It premiered on August 1, 2007 where it showed the reactions of couples living in the same building to similar situations they deal with in their daily lives. The series was cancelled due to its low audience on August 30, 2009. Afterwards a sequel was made called Escenas de matrimonio 2, but the audience continued not to respond, which caused it to be cancelled as well.

overview: Kanade is an office worker who's unfulfilled in life...and keeps the fact that he's gay a secret. Everything changes when he reunites with an old classmate from high school: Mashiro, the boy Kanade secretly liked back in his youth. Mashiro's arrival seems to bring new sunlight to Kanade's dreary life. As they get to know each other again as adults, could this be Kanade's chance to find love with the one who got away?

overview: The Swabian term "chachappel" lovingly describes a "dye" or "depp", which stumbles naively and easily through life. This is how our hero Carlo Brenner, who comes from an Upper Swabian provincial village and is looking for himself, is also what he feels like.

overview: Stars in Their Eyes is a talent show with a twist - contestants aren't necessarily showcasing their own talents, but their ability to mimic their favourite singers. The audience votes for the best performance, and the winner from each show is invited back to perform again in the grand final, which was broadcast live, and viewers were able to vote for the winner. It has been presented by: Leslie Crowther, Matthew Kelly, Cat Deeley & Harry Hill.

Everything changes when ex-wife Jeanne flies to Italy and asks to look after the teenager. Kosha is not happy about the appearance of her sloppy father and wants to get rid of him, while Nikolai is looking for a way to return triumphantly to show business. A common cause will help them in this — an online dating agency.

overview: They meet, fall in love, and die across time—soulmates bound by fate, drawn together no matter how many times they're reborn. In a new life, they reunite once more. Can they escape the tragedy that keeps repeating? A love story of two people defying fate, where love and thunder collide.

overview: 3-2-1 was a popular (and very successful) British game show that was made by Yorkshire Television for ITV. It ran for ten years, between 29 July 1978 and 24 December 1988, with former Butlins Redcoat Ted Rogers as the host. It was based on a Spanish gameshow called Un, dos, tres... responda otra vez and was a trio of three shows in one, a quiz, a variety and game shows. The show was a huge success consistently pulling in large ratings. The first series, though, intended as a summer filler, attracted up to 16.5 million viewers and subsequent years never failed to peak below 12 million. The show occupied a Saturday early evening slot for most of its run. The final Christmas special (broadcast on 24 December 1988) attracted 12.5 million viewers.

The soap opera features as its central characters João, Jerônimo and Duda, three brothers who threaten the dominance of the powerful farmer Pedro Barros, the highest authority in the fictional Coroado, in the interior of Minas Gerais, where the story is set.
title: Irmãos Coragem

overview: The story of the Italian national team's unpredictable victory at the 2006 World Cup. Relive the memory of that great undertaking, told by the members of that unforgettable team.

overview: Jinwoo Seo, who died in an accident after being sidelined at work, suddenly wakes up in the past?! He's returned to the time before his idea was stolen and decides to quit… But when Executive Director Baek Eui-hyeon says just one thing, he ends up becoming the project lead instead!

His closest collaborators are the one-legged, phlegmatic Schremser (Walter Davy), who later becomes department chief, and the extremely stupid and incompetent Schrammel (C. A. Tichy), who is responsible for many of the more exhilarating moments of the show.

overview: A personal motive leads Moscow police captain Novikov to the province to investigate two seemingly unrelated crimes. Novikov's favorite journalist Eva drowned while swimming in a lake in a remote village in the Pskov region. Her death is recognized as an accident, but Victor believes that she was massacred by those involved in her regular investigation. At the same time, in the vicinity of the village committed a daring raid on the car of a well-known Pskov businessman. The car was delivering a large sum of cash to the settlement. The cashier and two guards accompanying the valuable cargo were killed, and 15 million rubles disappeared without a trace. Investigating the robbery, Novikov realizes that the raid on the cashier and Eva's death are connected. Major Kazantsev, head of the local police department, becomes Novikov's assistant, but his goal is not only to find and punish those responsible, but also to preserve the fragile peace between the villagers and the local Roma community.

overview: By day, Tom works in his mother's clothing store, and by night, he trolls the internet with furious and infamous comments. When hackers reveal his identity and expose it to the public, he dresses in women's clothing to escape social persecution. A story about the path from hatred and isolation to intimacy and reconciliation.

But the more she gets to know them, the more attached she becomes. Alice must make a choice: betray her new friends or escape with them.

overview: Suzume Tōjō is just three months away from turning forty and realizes there's so much he hasn't done with his life! So, he makes a plan: create a private list of things he's always wanted to do and check them off before turning the big four-oh. It's a rather simple list, filled with goals that should be easy to accomplish, like a takoyaki party, enjoying a parfait out in a cafe, and spending his birthday with a lover. Except, that last one comes with a major problem—Tōjō hasn't had a lover in ten years! But when Keishi Tanaka, Tōjō's handsome junior at the company, discovers the secret list, he's determined to help Tōjō check off every single item—starting with the "lover" part!

overview: Tom Turbo is a series of books by Austrian author Thomas Brezina. The stories feature Tom Turbo, a bike who is able to talk and do one hundred and eleven tricky things. He and his friends Karo (Karolin Klicker) and Klaro (Konstantin Klicker) try to catch 'the ever bad guy' Fritz Fantom. With each of the original books, a detective gimmick would be delivered which would be used by Karo and Klaro during the current 'case'.

overview: The shared living arrangement of three men and women who all fall for the irresistibly charming "natural-born angel" Kita-kun, whose mysterious appeal captivates everyone he meets. To avoid adding more rivals in love, the three individuals form the "33% Club", vowing to equally share Kita's love in thirds. As they clash and grow, the three begin to discover what truly matters most in life.

overview: In the quiz show Q1 - Ein Hinweis ist falsch (Q1 - A clue is wrong) two candidates play together as a team and have to demonstrate the right mix of combination, concentration, knowledge and risk. A good education alone is not enough - it also depends on how well they know each other and can assess what the other knows. Together they have to work out the right answers. Everything revolves around clues. First, the topic of the term they are looking for is announced. With the help of four clues, the candidates have to get on the right track - but only three of them are correct. In addition, the course of the game and the moderator work together to ensure that it is not too easy to find the right answer. Wrong clues can lead the team astray. Players receive 100 euros for each correct answer. There is no upper limit, as the game only ends when a team decides to drop out and leave the show with their previous winnings - or if a question is answered incorrectly. In this case, however, the team loses everything it has won up to that point.
title: Q1 - Ein Hinweis ist falsch

overview: In Osaka, two trapped boys, a dark and confined space, their shared struggle, a journey of rescue and mutual redemption.

overview: With humor and wit, El Vítor explores the spicy soul of Mexico. More than a fruit, the chile represents identity and challenge. Between laughter, flavors, and fire, Al Chile is a declaration of love for the heat that burns on the plate and in the heart.

overview: Nederland in Beweging! is a program on Dutch television aimed at stimulating physical activity. The goal of the program is to get people more active. The program focuses mainly on people over fifty.
title: Nederland in Beweging!

overview: Arina and Borya love each other, they are happy, and they feel good together. Because they left all the most boring, unhappy, sad and difficult things in their first "milk" marriages and entered into a second one. Into a second marriage, where you can be honest, real, and imperfect. In a second marriage, where you can save money on the wedding, because you already know for sure that it won't pay off. A second marriage is not about socks, underpants, mortgages, problems and difficulties. The second marriage is about love! They say there are no perfect relationships, but there are some that you want to tell people about.

overview: About young people who turned their disabilities into content for social networks and became incredibly successful at it.

overview: The Price is Right in the UK was hosted by Leslie Crowther (1984–88), Bob Warman (1989–94), Bruce Forsyth (1995–01), and Joe Pasquale (2006–07). It ran discontinuously from 24 March 1984 to 8 April 1988, with a second run from 1989 to 1994, a third run from 4 September 1995 to 16 December 2001 and a fourth run from 8 May 2006 until 12 January 2007.

overview: Can Bonomo, Can Temiz and Can Sungur will play a number of games and create fun content, along with their topics from the "O Tarz Mı?" podcast.

overview: "What Then?" is an interactive series about tactics in the male-female relationship. In the series with Deniz Işın and Sarp Bozkurt in leading roles, two characters who could not find the love they have been searching for yet, just give up and begin to consult different tactic books. We will watch funny and emotional moments of Sarp and Deniz, who ruin their date because of the tactics they read in the book, as they try to know each other. In fact, not only will we watch it, but we will also watch and see how the story goes on with different endings by deciding on the progress of the story thanks to the options we come across.

overview: Mesut Süre, which has drawn a unique and pioneering path both in the world of humor and in the field of talk shows! Mesut Süre talks to the lonely, about loneliness, the reasons for loneliness, whether loneliness is "sultanism" or "desperation", over the loneliness of his guests - in his own words - "making people laugh like a bear". Every week, three consonant(!) names are guests on Mesut's stage. Faced with three loners, Mesut scrutinizes his guests' stories of loneliness (for example, unsuccessful flirtations, abandonment, deception, etc.)

overview: Kübra, who is trying to hold on to the cinema and television world, sometimes meets with fringe directors who target festivals in her casting auditions; Sometimes it intersects with opportunistic producers aiming for totality. overview: Love, hatred, passion, inconsistency, anger, meatballs, headman, shooting scenes, necessary and unnecessary big movements, the rule of law, the desolate man in the desolate man and many more… Thirty-two different stories, one world, from the creators of KALT and Errands.

overview: A Very Peculiar Practice is a black comedy with surreal elements. It concerned an idealistic young doctor, Stephen Daker, taking up a post as a member of a university medical centre. The centre is staffed by a group of misfits including the bisexual Rose Marie, self-absorbed Bob Buzzard, and decrepit Scot, Jock McCannon who heads the team in the first series.

overview: These stories are as real as they are tragicomic. Volkan Oge reveals lived and absurd stories with his guests.

overview: In a luxury bunker designed to endure any imaginable catastrophe, a group of billionaires is forced to coexist after locking themselves in due to the threat of an unprecedented global conflict. Kimera Underground Park becomes a claustrophobic setting for two families marked by a wound from the past. Isolated underground and with no possibility of escape, they unleash personalities uncovering their most unconfessable secrets. But the most unexpected alliances also emerge. An excessive and surprising emotional X-ray of billionaires living in a golden hole.

overview: Neighbourhood Watch with a digital upgrade! Matt Allwright has gobsmacking stories of crafty crooks and dodgy deliveries caught on camera, and top tips to help make a safer street.

overview: Dover 24/7: Britain's Busiest Port takes viewers inside one of the UK's most critical transport hubs, the Port of Dover. The series takes viewers inside some of the key port control centres to meet frontline staff and shine a light on the teamwork, expertise, operational challenges, and crucial minute-by-minute decisions that impact millions around the UK to reveal some of the huge 24/7 operation that keeps the nation's most important transport hub open for business. From the terminal and port control teams to the Port of Dover Police and the ferry and cruise companies, viewers will get to know the individuals keeping the port moving around the clock.
title: Dover 24/7: Britain's Busiest Port

overview: The Altruists tells the story of Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison, two hyper-smart, ambitious young idealists who tried to remake the global financial system in the blink of an eye – and then seduced, coaxed and teased each other into stealing $8 billion.
title: The Altruists
